candidates.hypothesis: F5 corrected by the confirmation run: paper lightened from 'warm yellowed dun' (measured L* 74-81 on the paper, owner: 'chut chut too dark' on 10/15) to 'light aged cream with a soft yellow cast', aiming at the band the owner did not complain about (strict paper L* 83-90, b* 20-26; C_066_paltas 'actually perfect' = 82.5/23.6, first-survey F3/F2 winners 86.5/22-23). The L (sourced Lithuanian) people block becomes the default, condensed, with the owner's hair rules (women blond/light-brown, younger straight or faintly waved, older set/curled or headscarf; some moustaches; caps on working men). 'Gaze slightly off the viewer' is replaced by a distribution: varied natural angles, most looking at task or each other, one or two facing the viewer with eyes just past the viewer's shoulder. Inset variety stated in lead and suffix. Vignette composition. Default for object, clothing, person and single-figure verb cards.
candidates.lead: A printed page from a 1981 Lithuanian civil-defence training album, drawn and printed like the Soviet Grazhdanskaya Oborona wall charts of 1975-1985: dark-brown brush-and-ink outlines around every figure and object, matte gouache fills with soft shading, four-colour offset with a faint coarse halftone, muted inks of dusty blue, olive, ochre, brick red and grey-brown on light aged cream paper with a soft yellow cast. The light paper is the background: the main subject is drawn directly on it, its surroundings sketched in around it and fading into the paper, leaving open margins; insets are small ruled boxes on the same paper, each a clearly different moment or detail. Flat even diagram lighting, a quiet nostalgic warmth. People are ordinary Lithuanians of 1981, anonymous types with correct natural proportions: fair skin, ash-blond to light-brown hair, grey or blue-grey eyes, broad-cheeked oval faces, straight noses, calm closed mouths, austere and plainly handsome. Men side-parted or cropped, some moustached, working men in flat caps; younger women lean, hair straight or faintly waved; older women with set or curled hair or a cotton headscarf; plain loose clothes in brown, olive, dusty blue, grey and dull red. Heads turn at varied natural angles, as in a documentary photograph; one or two face the viewer, eyes resting just past the viewer's shoulder.
candidates.suffix: Finish: muted offset print on light aged cream paper, softly yellowed, brush-ink outlines, soft shading, correct proportions. Heads at varied natural angles, most people looking at their task or at each other, one or two facing the viewer with eyes resting just past the viewer's shoulder. Every inset a clearly different moment. Diagram arrows and callouts in solid black ink.

staging_fixes.108_minia: Main subject: a dense standing crowd of ordinary townspeople, many heads deep, filling the picture; faces at mixed angles, several turned to neighbours, a few facing forward with eyes just past the viewer. Insets: a queue boarding a bus; a crowded tram stop (both crowds, so the insets vote for the target word).
staging_fixes.366_eiti: Motion strip of three clearly different phases of the same man: standing with feet together; left leg forward, right arm forward; right leg forward, left arm forward. Arrow in solid black ink.
staging_fixes.454_letas: Tortoise moving slowly as the main subject; the hare awake and running at full stretch in its inset, so the fast/slow contrast is unmistakable.
staging_fixes.090_seima: Four people: one parent facing the viewer with eyes just past the viewer's shoulder, the other parent turned toward the children, the children looking at each other or at what they hold.
staging_fixes.137_vestuves: Bride and groom looking at each other or at the ring; one guest facing the viewer, the others watching the couple.
staging_fixes.147_karas: Refugees looking along the road ahead; one child glancing back toward the viewer; arrows and callouts in black ink.
staging_fixes.113_gydytojas: Keep the small red cross on the clinic building or medical kit; one doctor facing the viewer, the other attending to a patient.
staging_fixes.024_miestas: A Lithuanian town rather than a metropolis: five-storey panel blocks beside older brick and plastered buildings, a church tower in the distance, an Ikarus bus; people secondary to the street.
staging_fixes.041_klubas: The hall itself as the subject: a low stage with a small band, a bar or cloakroom, the lit entrance in an inset; dancers secondary.
staging_fixes.066_paltas: Standing man in a flat cap, three-quarter view, eyes on something to the side; coat flat-laid as the main subject.
staging_fixes._general_people: In every multi-person scene the figures look in different directions; at most two faces address the viewer, and those rest their eyes just past the viewer's shoulder.
staging_fixes._general_insets: Each inset shows a different moment, object or angle from the others and from the main picture; motion strips alternate limbs.
staging_fixes._lithuanian_detail_slot: Reserve one short sentence per card for the research agent's Lithuanian detail (farmstead woodwork, roadside cross, rye bread, linen, amber, interwar book spines without readable text, etc.), appended after the subject sentence.
